distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Guizhou and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) provides an earlier first-Taiwan record from Nantou, Sun Moon Lake, collected on http://11.vi.2005 and http://25.vi.2005.

host_note: The Smith et al. (2020) source directly reports Magnolia grandiflora; the species-level host is promoted without extrapolation. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown, so it does not alter the current host summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus diversepilosus (Eggers, 1941).
